rounds.text: This fundamental turnaround is directly outperforming broader market expectations, as evidenced by profit growth outpacing one-year price growth by 60% [E40]. Furthermore, the company achieves a positive return on equity of 7.69%, which successfully beats the sector benchmark of 6.3% [E8]. Market pessimism is profoundly overdone given that the stock languishes at a mere 13% of the way up its 52-week range [E4], leaving the modest ₹ 42.0 Cr market capitalization [E2] drastically detached from its emerging earnings acceleration [E47]. Conceded: the company exhibits a negative price-to-book ratio on filed statements [E1], a dismal ten-year compounded profit growth rate of just 1% [E11], and a severely depressed return on assets of -89.11% [E7].
